lead: Landing on Mars takes about seven minutes from the top of the air to the ground, and the lander must do it all by itself.
try: Press Let the autopilot fly it to watch a full landing.
points: Mars's air is thin: it slows a lander, but not nearly enough to land safely.
So a heat shield, a parachute and rocket engines all have to work, one after another.
Radio signals take minutes to reach Earth, so nobody can steer it live.
